> AshStorage analyzers and variants backed by the xberg document intelligence sidecar

## Modules

- [AshStorageXberg](AshStorageXberg.md): AshStorage analyzers and variants backed by the
[xberg](https://github.com/xberg-io/xberg) document intelligence engine.

- Analyzers
  - [AshStorageXberg.Analyzers.Audio](AshStorageXberg.Analyzers.Audio.md): Technical metadata of audio and video files.
  - [AshStorageXberg.Analyzers.ContentType](AshStorageXberg.Analyzers.ContentType.md): Sniffs the real MIME type of an upload via the sidecar's dedicated
`POST /detect` endpoint — no extraction, so this is cheap enough to run
eagerly on every attachment.
  - [AshStorageXberg.Analyzers.Document](AshStorageXberg.Analyzers.Document.md): Bibliographic metadata of documents: PDF, Office (OOXML and legacy), ODF, RTF,
and EPUB.
  - [AshStorageXberg.Analyzers.Image](AshStorageXberg.Analyzers.Image.md): Image dimensions, format, and EXIF tags.
  - [AshStorageXberg.Analyzers.Text](AshStorageXberg.Analyzers.Text.md): Extracted text of any format the sidecar supports — the headline feature:
PDF, Office/ODF, HTML, email, archives, notebooks, source code, and (with
`ocr: true`) images.

- Variants
  - [AshStorageXberg.Variants.ExtractedText](AshStorageXberg.Variants.ExtractedText.md): `AshStorage.Variant` that stores the full extracted text of a document as a
sidecar file — the right home for text too large for the blob metadata map
(see `AshStorageXberg.Analyzers.Text` and its `:max_bytes` cap).
  - [AshStorageXberg.Variants.PageThumbnail](AshStorageXberg.Variants.PageThumbnail.md): `AshStorage.Variant` that renders a page of a document to an image, using the
xberg sidecar's page rasterization.
  - [AshStorageXberg.Variants.Transcript](AshStorageXberg.Variants.Transcript.md): `AshStorage.Variant` that stores the Whisper transcript of an audio or video
file, produced by the xberg sidecar.

- Xberg client
  - [AshStorageXberg.Formats](AshStorageXberg.Formats.md): Supported-format lookup for `accept?/1` callbacks, backed by the sidecar's
`GET /formats` endpoint.
  - [AshStorageXberg.Xberg](AshStorageXberg.Xberg.md): The exchangeable xberg interface.
  - [AshStorageXberg.XbergApi](AshStorageXberg.XbergApi.md): REST implementation of `AshStorageXberg.Xberg`, backed by an xberg sidecar
(`ghcr.io/xberg-io/xberg`, `xberg serve`).
